description: Sets or changes the rooms of an already shown plan — names, area_m2 or length_m × width_m, floor type, bathroom (wet), level, ceiling height — stores them with the plan and recalculates material quantities and labour (manual quantities are kept). Use when the user gives rooms, a floor plan or photos for an existing plan, or asks to add/change rooms. view_id from show_renovation_plan / open_plan. Send the FULL room list (it replaces the old one). save_only: true stores rooms without recalculating. The updated plan is shown to the user.
name: recalc_plan
title: Recalculate plan
